scientific_integrity: The analytic finite-difference and quadratic-zero argument establishes all real-parameter cases; finite torsion tests are only supplementary. Neither publication nor independent audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only strictly positive reflection-symmetric masses on five fixed consecutive integer sites. No extension to nonsymmetric weights or higher support sizes. A complete proof and supplemental exact tester are supplied; originality is relative to inspected sources and earlier unindexed weighted quadrature literature remains a risk.
title: Five-atom Fourier orthogonality: exact phase stratification and irrational triples
